exec.description: Run a command in the container.

httpGet.description: Request to an HTTP endpoint of the container.

tcpSocket.description: Connection to a TCP port of the container.

grpc.description: gRPC health check of the container.

initialDelaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait after the container started before the first probe.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds after which the probe times out.

periodSeconds.description: How often (in seconds) the probe runs.

successThreshold.description: Consecutive successes needed to be considered successful after a failure.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures needed to be considered failed.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period before the container is stopped when this probe fails.

description: Probe of the container. Set one of `exec`, `httpGet`, `tcpSocket` or `grpc`.
